Fuji Speedway — circuit survey

id fujiJapan · Japanese GP (retired, classic)theme greenday circuit (night:false)clockwisesha 13ecfd5 (survey branch cursor/fuji-survey-a1)2026-10-15

Read-only survey. No js/ or css/ edits. Working tree = deploy tip e3a27bc + shared-shot-tooling + PR #1979 daytime weather/lighting merge (both applied cleanly). Renderer: TLX under SwiftShader (no GPU), orbit/eye free camera, 960 px source frames shown at ≤800 px. Frames are character-faithful but soft-presented; treat colour as indicative.

Verdict

Centreline, props and audits are clean (verify OK, 0 floating props, all counts at baseline). The visible weaknesses are art/lighting, not geometry: Mount Fuji reads as a tan pyramid (not snow-capped), the plateau is sparse rather than dense cedar, the pit/stand buildings have no night lighting, overcast and fog leave a clear-blue sky, and two orbit stations never present at dusk/night dry.

Code & scenery deep-dive

Read line by line: js/circuits/fuji.js (70 lines), js/circuits/scenery/fuji.js (560 lines), docs/tracks/fuji.md, docs/SCENERY-API.md. Call-site counts are static (a loop multiplies them).

Def tables. sceneryCoordinates:"racing", _sceneryShift undefined, startFrac 0, reverse:false, so every K(s)/frac in the scenery file is a racing-lap fraction with no shift. No hwZones, bankZones, bridges, elevations (null), pit or undulate: width, banking and elevation come entirely from the OSM-derived path.pts plus the engine's default relief. terrainOuter:110, flatTerrain:false. kit: cabin marshal posts, wArmco rails, panelled fence, tyre stacks, monopole boards, portal gantry. standSet: steel/alu/concrete. furniture.lamp:"none" and night:false mean there is no lamp or floodlight emitter anywhere (none in the scenery file either).

Audit cross-check. Guard drops building=3 tree=3 pine=1 are props the engine refused around the 300R fold (scenery header lines 31-35 explain the +1 rail/fence gap 0.700-0.718). Clip 2 severe, coplanar 7, buried 12, flatCoplanar 4 are at their committed baselines, so none is a regression; the scenery comments show each was chased individually (e.g. :247-251 transporters, :456-459 300R crown float). graph-parity was not run (this scenery is not migrated to TrackGraph.instance and the survey is read-only).
Rendered defect → code.
  • Tan cone: addMountain(... snow [0.97,0.98,1.00], rock [0.42,0.40,0.44], snowline 0.28) at :206-211 is white in source; frames show beige by day, so colour is lost downstream (sun colour [0.94,0.92,0.86] × vertex colour, plus fog [0.62,0.66,0.68] density 0.0022 over 3.2 km). Cause suspected, not isolated.
  • Sparse plateau: every forestEdge call at :365-503 passes density 0.15-0.30, and the global ranks at :512-537 skip 28% of nodes; together they give the lone-tree look in frames 03-05.
  • Unlit night: no lamp furniture (fuji.js:60), night:false (:27), every building lit:false (scenery :98-498). The engine only authors night scenery for night:true circuits (survey-track note).
  • Apron slab at s=0: groundPatch(K(0.944), 1, 27, [26,0.16,54], TARMAC) :118 is the only 54 m flat patch beside the start; the orbit camera at s=0 looks across it.
  • Turn mapping: turns[] (fuji.js:~48) is the 16 sharpest curvature peaks; scenery comments assume named corners at fixed fracs (0.707=300R, 0.739=Dunlop), but the measured 14 m hairpin sits at 0.707.
Real-world cross-check (source claims, not measurements). Fuji Speedway ≈4.563 km, 16 corners, ≈1.5 km main straight, ≈580 m altitude (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuji_Speedway). Mount Fuji bearing 266.1° is the brief's own computation from 35.3714 N 138.9267 E, not re-derived. Hotel/museum facts as cited in docs/tracks/fuji.md (https://global.toyota/en/newsroom/corporate/37094898.html, https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124297). I did not re-fetch these pages this session, so they are the brief's claims. Grandstand capacity 110 000 and the 33 m elevation range are unverified estimates.

Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

Not captured / uncertain

  • Missing frames: orbit @0 at dusk-dry (fuji-43) and night-dry (fuji-55) — awaitSoftPresent timed out ×3 each (90 s then 150 s), while the same station in day-dry and dusk/night-rain presented. Cause unknown (tooling or a real renderer stall for that scene).
  • Cut: trackside and cinematic views, eye views in weather/dusk/night, sectors other than the six stations, dawn, a driven-lap clip (flicker/z-fight cannot be judged from stills).
  • Real-corner mapping: the 16 curvature peaks were not matched to real corner names. Left/right count (10R/6L) not compared with a real map; Coca-Cola (T3) is a left in-game. Treat as unverified.
  • verify-track reports a 5.37 m node radius at node 278 (s≈0.246); the curvature array gives 21 m at the T1 apex node. The two measures differ; whether T1 has a sub-hw radius is unconfirmed.
  • Elevation is source-authored or surveyed (def.elevations is null here); not checked against dated real-world data.
  • Colour judgements are from SwiftShader soft-present frames on a GPU-less VM and not evidence for a player's GPU.
